definition: National Data Integration Platform providing services, capabilities, governance controls and data products for NHS England.
A grouped collection of NDIT services, capabilities, governance controls and assets delivered together to support a business outcome.
A process or pathway followed by users to achieve a specific objective within NDIT.
A business or technical function delivered by NDIT, such as Dataset Onboarding, Data Ingress or Governance Management.
A grouped set of datasets, information assets and services organised around a specific healthcare domain or business area.
A role or user type interacting with NDIT, such as Analyst, Data Engineer or Product Owner.
A service supporting dataset discovery, onboarding, reference data management and controlled access to data assets.
Palantir Foundry platform used for data integration, transformation, modelling, analytics and operational workflows.
Messaging Exchange for Social Care and Health. A secure NHS service used to transfer healthcare-related files and messages.
A platform capability supporting secure movement and transfer of approved data.
Data Virtual Environment used for analytical development, experimentation and controlled access activities.
Capability governing user access requests, approvals and permissions for NDIT services and datasets.
Process for introducing a new dataset into NDIT including governance, ingestion, validation, testing and operational readiness.
Process of bringing source data into NDIT services and analytical platforms.
Capability used to verify data quality, completeness, format and fitness for purpose before use.
Process of exporting approved data from NDIT services to authorised consumers or destinations.
Capability supporting governance assessments, approvals, compliance reviews and assurance processes.
Data Sharing Agreement defining the legal and operational arrangements for sharing data between organisations.
Data Protection Impact Assessment used to assess and mitigate privacy and data protection risks.
Assessment of security controls, risks and compliance requirements prior to onboarding, implementation or change.
Formal approval process required before granting access to data, services or environments.
Architecture and design review forum responsible for approving significant technical decisions and solution designs.
Standard document, form or artefact used to support governance, onboarding or delivery activities.
Technical role responsible for onboarding, integration, transformation, movement and management of datasets.
Role responsible for analysing datasets, producing reports and generating insights from data products.
Role responsible for developing technical solutions, integrations and platform components.
Role accountable for operation, delivery and lifecycle management of services.
Role responsible for prioritisation, business value and product outcomes.
Role responsible for solution design, architecture governance and technical decision-making.
Role responsible for privacy, governance compliance, DPIA review and DSA oversight.
Individual consuming NDIT services, reports, dashboards or operational outputs.
Collection containing datasets, services and analytical capabilities supporting virtual ward services.
Collection containing datasets, integrations and reporting assets related to cancer programmes and services.
Collection containing datasets and assets supporting population health analytics and reporting.
Collection containing datasets and assets supporting mental health services and reporting.
Collection containing datasets and assets supporting primary care services and analysis.
Collection supporting data products, datasets and services associated with the CWT domain.
